parts.name: D00089 Burger
parts.reasoning: For rigid body simulation, this composite organic object must be approximated as a single solid entity. The mass is estimated at 0.3 kg, representing a standard large burger. The density (500 kg/m^3) is an average, balancing the lightweight porous bun with the denser, moisture-rich meat and vegetables. Since food items are highly inelastic and absorb impact energy, the restitution is set very low (0.1). Friction coefficients are estimated based on the dry, slightly textured surface of baked bread interacting with typical surfaces. A convex decomposition is recommended for the collision geometry to roughly match the cylindrical shape while enveloping the irregular protrusions of the lettuce and patty.
